facts.fact: L'Echo d'Algerie reports the Interior Ministry mobilised DZD 664 million to generalise the national addressing reference (RNA) in a first phase in the pilot wilayas of Bouira, Sidi Bel-Abbes, Ouargla and Constantine, with a national addressing committee set up to steer it.

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Local Authorities and Territorial Planning, with ASAL

DZA.note: The document is about addressing and says nothing on local government office connection.
